newsitem.title: USA: CDI Corp to sell engineering division.
newsitem.headline: CDI Corp to sell engineering division.

text.p: CDI Corp said Monday it plans to sell the in-house engineering division of its automotive unit, in addition to the manufacturing technologies division it previously announced would be sold.
CDI said in a release that "certain other companies with strong ties to the automotive industry will provide an excellent fit for these operations."
A representative at CDI's public relations firm said the company is already in talks to sell the division but could not comment on the interested buyers.

CDI said the automotive engineering division reported revenues of about $70 million in 1996, while manufacturing technologies revenues were about $45 million and automotive staffing activities had 1996 revenues of about $120 million.
CDI said it will retain its automotive staffing activities, which are closely allied with the company's core technical services business.
